message: test(runtime): restrict failure injection to supported settle hooks

edits.find: /** What one rig's hooks do beyond recording, and the whole of what a case configures. */
A completed batch's diagnostics still reach the existing diagnostics owner.
edits.replace: A batch returned by invalidation still hands its diagnostics to the existing diagnostics owner; if invalidation throws instead, no returned batch is available to record.

edits.find: `#assertLive` is asked in three places and the count is the design.
edits.replace: Liveness is inspected at three points: two refusals and one publication skip.
